items.name: HOMESTEAD HELLES LAGER
items.description: A gold coloured, easy-drinking German lager with a grainy sweet and herbal hop aroma. The flavour is lightly bready with honeycomb and a neutral, earthy hop character. A refreshing and flavourful lager that is familiar and friendly to all.

items.name: COLOUR MY WORLD HAZY IPA (Silver Winner - Canada Beer Cup 2025)
items.description: Our flagship IPA. Juicy pineapple, mango, and lemon zest dominate the aroma with some light pine in the back end. The flavour is likewise full of tropical fruit and citrus with a refreshing, moderate bitterness that doesn’t overwhelm the palate. A favourite among many.

items.name: VIOLETS AT DAWN BLUEBERRY BASIL ALE (Bronze Winner - Alberta Beer Awards 2025)
items.description: A welcoming aroma of blueberry, fresh basil, and light mint. The flavour mirrors the aroma with moderately sweet blueberry and blackberry, while the basil lightly cools the palate with a refreshing, light finish.

items.name: GODSPEED IRISH EXTRA STOUT (Gold Winner - Alberta Beer Awards 2025) *Can Pour Only
items.description: A classic stout featuring aromas of dark rye bread, black cherry, and dark chocolate. The flavours showcase the roasted and chocolate malts along with notes of molasses and coffee without tasting burnt or astringent. Hop character is not assertively bitter and balances the lingering sweetness on the palate.

items.name: LAVENDER HAZE SOUR
items.description: A sour Berliner Weisse brewed with Guava and Lavender. The aroma greets you with a light lavender potpourri scent and tropical guava. The flavour highlights fresh lavender flowers and juicy sweet guava accentuated by moderate tartness which slowly fades into a gentle flowery tingle at the end of the palate.

items.name: TOSS THE FEATHERS - IRISH RED ALE
items.description: An Irish Red Ale with a beautiful auburn colour. A smooth taste of fresh pumpernickle bread & toffee. Exceptionally refreshing example of an irish classic. perfect for crushing on a patio.

items.name: NEON NIGHTS - LIGHT LAGER
items.description: Light malt profile, hops come with a delicate aroma of ripe strawberries, honeydew and lemon zest. The flavour shifts to citrus forward with kumquat, orange and lime. She’s smooth, refreshing and crisp! A patio staple in this taproom.

items.name: THE DEVIL'S ORCHARD - GOLDEN STRONG ALE
items.description: Our second anniversary brew! Taste of baked pears and vanilla. With a pleasant floral aroma. This is a strong beer but crisp and dry!

items.name: BEYOND MEASURE - BELGIAN WITBIER
items.description: A traditional Belgian Witbier with a perfumy aroma of lemony coriander and sweet chamomile. Refreshing, dry, slightly tangy flavour with lingering orange peel and vanilla to finish.

items.name: DUNGEON CRAWLERS - BRITISH BLONDE ALE - COLLABORATION WITH PARALLEL 49
items.description: Our first collaboration brew with parallel 49 is a classic british blonde ale. A perfect springtime crusher with flavours of white peach, lime zest, and tangerine.

items.name: GUEST TAP - BRAMBLE ON - SUNNY CIDER
items.description: Triple berry, This cider was flavoured with Blackberry, Blueberries and raspberries. A lovely, dry cider with a punch of berry at the end.
